mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's rate hikes (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) trigger a temporary market correction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 6.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output, which precedes corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 200000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During recessionary demand contraction (RSAFS declining for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences further declines in the next 5 trading days due to deteriorating economic outlook.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
